title: ranunculus inchoatus
intro: Ranunculus inchoatus, commonly known as the Indian crowfoot, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region, belonging to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). The plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus inchoatus include alkaloids, glycosides, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
